train_dev_test_targets.leakage_prevention: All mutations sharing the same source passage ID are clustered exclusively into the same split

mutation_strategy.numerical: Extract exact numerical thresholds from canonical passages, apply bounded mutations (+-50%, order of magnitude, or substitution) and store original_value and mutated_value
mutation_strategy.modality: Invert mandatory 'shall/must' into discretionary 'may/voluntarily choose' or permissive into prohibitive
mutation_strategy.temporal: Pair superseded/omitted historical provisions (2013/2015) against current consolidated law (2020)
mutation_strategy.adversarial: Apply cross-case holding transplantation, section displacement, and statutory negation attacks
mutation_strategy.compound: Construct multi-clause answers where one clause is factually true and secondary clause is ungrounded or contradicted

acceptance_criteria: G1: Schema validity across all records
G2: Required 16 fields present in every record
G3: Provenance traceable to Dataset 1 or Dataset 2
G4: Source passage SHA-256 integrity verified
G5: Zero contamination with Dataset 3 queries or records
G6: Zero contamination with Baseline 1-5 evaluation queries
G7: Unique IDs across 100% of cases
G8: Zero duplicate or near-duplicate cases
G9: Zero source passage leakage across train/dev/test splits
G10: Class distribution reported and balanced
G11: Category distribution reported across all 11 categories
G12: Difficulty distribution documented and enforced
G13: Adversarial provenance and mutation operation recorded
G14: Temporal provenance and amendment history verified
G18: Freeze receipt sealed as FROZEN
